title: VIROME: Downloading Libraries of VIROME Data
author: Jaysheel Bhavsar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d5m845
materials: Go to VIROME web application . a
Once saved, navigate to the Finder. a
Double click the file to unzip it.

steps.title: Log in to VIROME
steps.instruction: Click the login button, then enter your username and password to authenticate into the application.

substeps.instruction: Enter username and password to authenticate into the application.

steps.title: Start library download
steps.instruction: Click the download button and then click the “download” option to begin downloading the library.

steps.title: Save file without renaming
steps.instruction: When prompted to save the file, accept the default file name and do not change it.

steps.title: Open FASTA files
steps.instruction: Open the downloaded FASTA files using TextEdit.
